FAMILY_CREST.title: Family Crest
FAMILY_CREST.description:
Your first combat is replaced by a shop.
After each elite combat, a shop opens.
Whenever you visit a shop, gain [blue]50[/blue] gold.
FAMILY_CREST.flavor: Closed doors are made for those with the right family name.
FAMILY_HONOR.title: Family Honor
FAMILY_HONOR.description:
Your first combat is replaced by a shop.
After each elite combat, a shop opens.
Shop prices are reduced by [blue]20%[/blue].
Whenever you visit a shop, gain [blue]100[/blue] gold.
FAMILY_HONOR.flavor: Honor is not a title. It is the line on the bill you can always pay.
PLATINUM_SHIELD.title: Platinum Shield
PLATINUM_SHIELD.flavor: Too heavy to shine, too expensive to throw away.
OLD_STATUE.title: Statue of the Old Era
OLD_STATUE.description: At the start of your [blue]4th[/blue] turn, transform all [gold]Strikes[/gold] into [gold]Ultimate Strikes[/gold] for this combat.
NOBLE_MARK.title: Noble Mark
NOBLE_MARK.description:
At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Upon pickup, duplicate [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Strikes[/gold] or [gold]Defends[/gold] in your deck.
NOBLE_MARK.flavor: Some seals are recognized faster than orders.
BLACK_DIAMOND.title: Black Diamond
BLACK_DIAMOND.description:
Upon pickup, upgrade all [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold].
Whenever you reach a rest site, add a random [gold]Ultimate Strike[/gold] or [gold]Ultimate Defend[/gold] to your deck.
BLACK_DIAMOND.flavor: A family's light is most expensive when it shines black.
GOLD_CIRCLET.title: Gold Circlet
GOLD_CIRCLET.description:
Can appear again even if already purchased.
At the start of combat, randomly gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] or [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
GOLD_CIRCLET.flavor: Some say it is not a crown, but a price tag.
COIN_BOX.title: Coin Box
COIN_BOX.description:
Upon pickup, obtain an [gold]Old Coin[/gold].
The next [blue]2[/blue] relics you obtain are replaced with [gold]Old Coins[/gold].
COIN_BOX.flavor: Shake it, and you can hear old wealth clinking together.
BOTTLED_CHAOS.title: Bottled Chaos
BOTTLED_CHAOS.description:
Upon pickup, choose a card to bottle.
At the start of each combat, the bottled card is in your opening hand.
BOTTLED_CHAOS.flavor: Even if the label falls off, whatever is inside still knows its owner.
BLANK_CHECK.title: Blank Check
BLANK_CHECK.description: Adds a [gold]Gold +15[/gold] option to card rewards.
BLANK_CHECK.flavor: It is already signed. Only the amount remains.
VAULT_KEY.title: Vault Key
VAULT_KEY.description: [gold]Rare[/gold] cards you buy in shops gain the [gold]Perk[/gold]: gain a random relic.
VAULT_KEY.flavor: The thing that opens the door is usually more expensive than the door itself.
SEA_GLASS.ARISTOCRAT.title: Golden Glass
